narrative.text: Nadia's reply is typed — of course it is typed, she is a journalist — on Veltrian Voice letterhead. It is blunt, professional, and more generous than you expected.

Chancellor. I have been investigating your government for months. You know what I have found. You also know that I have not published everything I have found — because some of it is still unverified, and I do not print what I cannot prove. Your offer of an exclusive is interesting. I will accept — on one condition. The exclusive must be complete. No omissions. No 'off the record' on matters of public interest. If you give me the whole story — your side of it, honestly, without spin — I will hold the rest of my investigation pending that exclusive. If you try to manage me, I will print everything. This is not a negotiation. This is your one opportunity to tell your story before I tell mine.

choices.text: "The whole story. No omissions. I have been keeping secrets so long I have forgotten what the truth feels like. Fine, Nadia. You will have your exclusive. And then Veltria will have the truth — and I will have to live with whatever the truth reveals about me."
